story.title: a bus stop horror story
paragraphs_en: This happpen when I am 70 years old. I would go to the gym,three to four times a week and ride the bus home. It was sunday _and i have just miss my bus,so i have to wait for longer for another one.
I woud'he called my parents by they were out of evening. And taxi chared more. So I decided to sit and wait in the bus shelter. It was a cold night and snow had just started preparing the ground.

My bus was takining longer than usual so I got my phone out and listened to some music. Almost an hour had passed. It was freezing and I had'nt seen anyone at all. that was'nt untill I noticed some things out of the corner of my eyes.

It was a creepy guy,dressed in thick layer of clothing,walking slowly towards me . I knew starting at him would draw more attention,so i just focused on my phone. He sat down at the other end of the shelter and just started at me. There was some thing off about him.
He seemed like he was either drunk or no drunks. He then asked. When is the bus due. I took out my earphone and said.

i think It's delayed because of the snow. He started at me for a while then started mumbling to himeself. He was realy starting to creepy me out,so Ipretened to be on my phone. After a couple of minute I took another look.
He'd moved closer to me. I looked away for a second then heard the sound of him sliding ever closer. I turned to him and said. you ok there?

He started with me with a glossy eyes,liffted his arm leaned towards me. Immedietaly,i grabbed my bag and ran as he fell to the ground. I kept going untill I go to the next bus stop. i turned around to check to see if he was there.
he was gone so I went to sit down. He came to hurt me . fortunetly the police shoot him.
Then he get driving licence. since in childhood i never travelled by bus.
